business_problem: Reduced research time from weeks to minutes by transforming 20M+ legacy records into searchable intelligence For over a century, the Indiana SOS has served as the steward of the state’s economic history, managing a massive repository of 20 million records.
solution_summary: Under the Captain Record initiative, Indiana SOS moved away from retrofitting legacy systems, and instead adopted a cloud-first strategy to turn their archives into living intelligence. In collaboration with Google Public Sector and partners mavQ , and Venturit , they leveraged Gemini models and Vertex AI Platform to build mission-critical tools. By integrating Google AI models like Veo and AI platform tooling through Vertex AI, the state can now reason across its entire historical archive, interpreting everything from 100-year-old handwriting to image-based scans. To manage this massive undertaking, Indiana SOS utilizes BigQuery as a centralized data warehouse to orchestrate and monitor the ingestion of 20 million legacy records. By replacing rigid keyword searches with plain-language discovery, agency staff can now locate critical information in minutes that previously took weeks or months.
